title: Merge dictation chunks into one message

message.text: Simplest fix, and the one I'm taking: send in larger chunks. Dictation will send at natural pauses of about 2.5 seconds, with everything said since the last send as one message of paragraphs. It never sends mid-sentence. A safety chunk at a sentence end still goes if you talk for over a minute or about 1,200 characters. Merging back-to-back owner messages into one bubble is a chat-display change, which manager-new-card owns, so I've passed that on. I'll tell you here when the chunking lands.

Noted both. On the equal bubble widths: that is chat styling, which manager-new-card owns, so I'm passing it to them. On the box holding the raw transcript while the chat shows the tidied version: I'm designing the chunking with that in mind. The box would keep exactly what Whisper heard, and the tidied text would go to the chat.

Landed, live and uncommitted: dictation now sends one message per natural pause (2.5 seconds of quiet after a finished sentence) instead of one per sentence. In a fake-clock test, 24 sentences over about 2 minutes gave 4 posts, and joined together they equal the spoken text. The 4-second tail send is kept, and one-sentence-per-send is now off by default but still a setting. The minion's report was cut off, so I don't know if the demo was updated. Equal bubble widths and merging back-to-back owner bubbles are with manager-new-card.
